value.summary: Rewrote README.md, docs/API.md and docs/OPERATIONS.md and added the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section. The docs now match the design: API-key auth (X-API-Key header, 401 body, fail closed, 16-character minimum), all 11 settings, HEAD probes, SQLite WAL with backups and the corrected locking runbook, pool sizing, the automatic links.expires_at startup upgrade with its exact log messages and manual SQL, link expiry (POST and PATCH, is_expired, idempotency rules), the 410 'Link has expired' redirect with no-store, the hourly stats endpoint (range rules, 744-hour cap, zero-filled example, %2B encoding) and the MySQL utf8mb4_bin ALTER. OPERATIONS.md gains the 'Campaign deployment' and 'Scaling beyond the campaign profile' sections. No 'no authentication' statement remains. Caveat: WP-4/WP-6 code is not merged yet, so expiry, PATCH, hourly stats, the expired 410/no-store behaviour and the startup upgrade/tuning wiring are documented from the design and must be re-checked after merge. compileall passes and the existing tests pass.
notes: Checked against the merged code: Settings fields, ranges and API_KEY validators (app/core/config.py); require_api_key (401, WWW-Authenticate: ApiKey, fail closed) and the app.security startup WARNING text; ensure_links_expires_at log messages and literal ALTER statements (app/core/schema.py); describe_engine/log_engine_tuning fields (app/core/db.py); the logging extra fields; the HEAD probes (app/api/health.py); the schemas (expires_at, is_expired, LinkExpiryUpdate extra=forbid, hourly models).

Written from the design contract because WP-4/WP-6 are not merged: the redirect expiry 410 and no-store on 404/410, the WARNING click log line, PATCH, the hourly endpoint and its 422 detail strings, SQL daily aggregation, and main.py's pool settings and lifespan order (create_all, then ensure_links_expires_at, then log_engine_tuning).

The 1.0.0 CHANGELOG Security entry is rewritten in place as a corrected entry, on the assumption that the 1.0.0 code already had API-key auth (the code says version 1.0.0 and enforces it). The [Unreleased] Security section records the correction. If auth was actually added after 1.0.0, that entry should be reworded.
No document contains 'no authentication', 'without authentication' or 'unauthenticated' (checked by regex search). Every Settings env name appears in the README configuration table.
python -m compileall -q app succeeds; python -m pytest -q passes.
open_issues: After WP-6 merges, check that app/main.py passes db_pool_size, db_max_overflow, db_pool_timeout_seconds and sqlite_busy_timeout_ms to create_db_engine and that the lifespan runs create_all, then ensure_links_expires_at, then log_engine_tuning. The startup steps and the pre-launch checklist in OPERATIONS.md depend on this.

After WP-4/WP-6 merge, check the documented strings against the code: 'expires_at must be in the future'; the hourly 422 details 'start and end must be supplied together', 'datetime out of range', 'start must be before end', 'range must not exceed 744 hours'; the WARNING 'failed to record click for link_id=%s (%s)'; and the redirect 404/410 Cache-Control: no-store.
Before launch, confirm the example campaign end 2025-12-31T23:59:00Z (year and time zone) with marketing.
Not tested: rolling back to the previous release (described as safe because it ignores the new column) and the PostgreSQL CSV copy steps in the scaling section.
The test that iterates over the Settings fields and checks each env name in README.md belongs to the test agent and is not written yet.
